text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel asked to observe Narita 
Brian's running. She said there was 
something she was curious about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And upon watching, the realization hit: 
Narita Brian was no longer able to run 
with the same form as before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A runner's true stride is vital to an 
Umamusume— once broken, it's hard to get 
back. ...Has Narita Brian lost hers?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel could painfully understand 
the agony of "not being able to run as one 
wishes."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She simply wants to stay by Narita Brian's 
side for now. Sakura Laurel continues to 
watch over her as she runs with all her 
might.
